mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_log (job_cd, manual_yn, status_cd, start_dt, reg_id, reg_ip) VALUES (#{jobCd}, #{manualYn}, 'BATCH01', NOW(), #{regId}, #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (job_cd) WHERE status_cd = 'BATCH01' DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_log SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, result_msg = #{resultMsg}, end_dt = NOW() WHERE batch_log_id = #{rowId}::integer AND status_cd = 'BATCH01'
UPDATE batch_log SET status_cd = 'BATCH03', result_msg = '서버 재시작으로 중단됨(처리 결과 확인 필요)', end_dt = NOW() WHERE status_cd = 'BATCH01'
mapper.select:
SELECT l.batch_log_id::TEXT AS row_id, l.job_cd, j.name AS job_name, l.manual_yn, l.status_cd, c.name AS status_name, l.result_msg, TO_CHAR(l.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS start_dt, TO_CHAR(l.end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS end_dt, l.reg_id, l.reg_ip FROM batch_log l LEFT JOIN batch_job j ON j.job_cd = l.job_cd LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = l.status_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'BATCH00'
ORDER BY l.batch_log_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM batch_log WHERE start_dt < NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL AND status_cd <> 'BATCH01'
